steps.title: Korean Food Culture
steps.body: Food is central to Korean culture. Meals are shared communally, with multiple side dishes (반찬, banchan) served alongside rice (밥) and soup (국). Koreans often greet each other with '밥 먹었어요?' (Did you eat?) — showing how deeply food is woven into daily life.

tip.label: The rice is the center
tip.text: In Korean culture, 밥 (bap) means both 'cooked rice' and 'a meal.' When Koreans say they haven't eaten, they say 밥을 못 먹었어요 — rice is so fundamental that it stands in for any meal.

steps.meaning: Cooked rice / meal — the cornerstone of Korean eating
steps.meaning_ja: ご飯 / 食事 ― 韓国食文化の中心

steps.meaning: Kimchi — fermented vegetables, the iconic Korean side dish
steps.meaning_ja: キムチ ― 発酵野菜、韓国の代表的なおかず

steps.meaning: Bulgogi — marinated grilled beef, beloved worldwide
steps.meaning_ja: プルコギ ― 甘辛いタレの焼き肉

steps.meaning: Bibimbap — mixed rice bowl with vegetables and gochujang sauce
steps.meaning_ja: ビビンバ ― 野菜とコチュジャンを混ぜたご飯

steps.meaning: Tteokbokki — spicy rice cakes, the most popular Korean street food
steps.meaning_ja: トッポッキ ― 辛い餅料理、最人気の屋台グルメ

steps.meaning: Samgyeopsal — grilled pork belly, the classic Korean BBQ cut
steps.meaning_ja: サムギョプサル ― 豚バラ肉の焼き肉

steps.meaning: Naengmyeon — cold noodles, a summer favorite
steps.meaning_ja: 冷麺 ― 夏の定番、冷たい麺料理

steps.meaning: Sundubu jjigae — soft tofu stew, often served bubbling hot
steps.meaning_ja: スンドゥブチゲ ― やわらかい豆腐の鍋

steps.meaning: Ramyeon — Korean instant noodles, a comfort food staple
steps.meaning_ja: ラーメン（インスタント）― 韓国のソウルフード

steps.meaning: Japchae — glass noodles stir-fried with vegetables and beef
steps.meaning_ja: チャプチェ ― 野菜と春雨の炒め物

steps.meaning: Water — served free at every Korean restaurant
steps.meaning_ja: 水 ― 韓国の飲食店では無料で提供される

steps.meaning: Coffee — Korea has one of the world's highest café densities
steps.meaning_ja: コーヒー ― 韓国はカフェ密度が世界トップクラス

steps.meaning: Soju — Korea's signature distilled spirit, the world's best-selling liquor
steps.meaning_ja: 焼酎 ― 韓国の代表的な蒸留酒、世界一売れる洋酒

steps.meaning: Beer — often mixed with soju to make 소맥 (somaek)
steps.meaning_ja: ビール ― 소주と混ぜると소맥（ソメク）になる

steps.meaning: Makgeolli — traditional milky rice wine, slightly sweet and fizzy
steps.meaning_ja: マッコリ ― 伝統的な米酒、甘くて少し炭酸がある

steps.meaning: Banchan — small side dishes served with every Korean meal
steps.meaning_ja: おかず（バンチャン）― 韓国の食事に必ず出る小皿料理

steps.meaning: Soup / broth — a separate soup dish served at most Korean meals
steps.meaning_ja: スープ / 汁物 ― ほとんどの韓国料理に付いてくる

steps.prompt: Korea's most famous distilled spirit, also the world's best-selling liquor, is called...

steps.title: Food & Drink Complete!
steps.message: 맛있게 드세요! (Bon appétit!) You've mastered essential Korean food and drink vocabulary. Food is one of the best conversation starters with Koreans — try asking 무슨 음식 좋아해요? (What food do you like?)
